content.user_title: Configure Buyer Context for PSP Research
content.value_statement: Generic prospecting guidance lacks the customer details needed for relevant research. This guided setup records your customer profile, buyer language, signal sources, and refresh rules for downstream PSP work.
actual_capabilities: Collect an ideal customer profile with segment, revenue range, sales motion, region, and exclusion criteria.
Draft a primary PSP with a public signal, operational pain, timing trigger, affected role, and buyer vocabulary.
Extract candidate buyer phrases from supplied content, or fetch source content when WebFetch is available.
Record signal sources, freshness windows, and PSP and vocabulary refresh cadences.
Capture anonymized stories, excluded topics, and the daily operational situation in SOUL.md.
Check existing setup files, offer refresh choices, and write brand-config.json and SOUL.md at the project root.
limitations: Accurate customer profiles, stories, and phrase selection depend on operator input.
Direct source fetching requires WebFetch; otherwise, the operator must paste source content.
The configuration template and related PSP skills are referenced but are not included in this reviewed skill directory.
The skill does not send outreach, run signal collection services, or independently validate business claims.

use_cases.title: Define a Focused ICP
use_cases.description: Turn a broad market idea into a customer segment with revenue range, sales motion, region, and exclusion criteria.

use_cases.title: Capture Buyer Language
use_cases.description: Extract candidate phrases from buyer writing and record anonymized stories for downstream PSP research.

use_cases.title: Set Research Operations
use_cases.description: Record signal sources, freshness windows, and refresh cadences in project configuration for consistent research.

prompt_templates.title: Start PSP Onboarding
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through PSP onboarding for [business]. Collect my customer profile, primary PSP, buyer language, signal sources, and anonymized stories. Flag missing details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new PSP workspace

prompt_templates.title: Define My ICP
prompt_templates.prompt: Refine my customer profile: [current profile]. Ask for revenue range, sales motion, region, and three to five exclusion criteria. Mark uncertain answers as placeholders.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Primary PSP
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [customer profile] and [pasted buyer writing] to draft a primary PSP. Include signal, pain, timing, affected role, and candidate phrases. Ask me to confirm phrases.
prompt_templates.scenario: Creating a focused PSP from supplied buyer evidence

prompt_templates.title: Refresh Existing PSP Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Review existing brand-config.json and SOUL.md against [market changes]. Propose updates to sources, phrases, boundaries, and refresh cadence. Preserve unrelated content and show proposed changes before writing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced maintenance of an existing research workspace

output_examples.input: We target sales-led B2B software companies with 50 to 200 employees in North America. We exclude agencies and consumer applications.
output: ICP: sales-led B2B software companies with 50 to 200 employees in North America.
Missing detail: annual recurring revenue range.

output_examples.input: The buyer excerpts I pasted mention missed handoffs, unclear ownership, and late pipeline changes.
output: Candidate buyer phrases: missed handoffs, unclear ownership, late pipeline changes.
Operator confirmation needed: select the phrases that match your customer segment.
Missing PSP details: a recent public signal, timing trigger, and affected role.

output_examples.input: Use weekly news research and manual job searches. Keep the default refresh schedule.
output: Signal sources: weekly news research and manual job searches.

best_practices: Use specific segments, measurable ranges, and explicit exclusions.
Use recent public buyer writing and anonymize customer stories before saving them.
Review proposed file changes and set refresh cadences before relying on saved context.
anti_patterns: Do not define the ICP with broad category labels alone.
Do not invent buyer phrases, stories, or signal evidence.
Do not store credentials or identifiable customer information in onboarding files.

faq.question: What does this skill configure?
faq.answer: It prepares brand-config.json and SOUL.md with customer profiles, a primary PSP, buyer vocabulary, signal sources, stories, boundaries, and refresh rules.

faq.question: Who should complete onboarding?
faq.answer: A founder, sales researcher, or revenue operations manager with reliable customer knowledge should provide and confirm the setup details.

faq.question: How long does onboarding take?
faq.answer: The author estimates about 15 minutes. Missing source material or unclear customer profiles may require more time.

faq.question: Does it research buyers automatically?
faq.answer: It can fetch and extract buyer phrases when WebFetch is available. Otherwise, you paste source content and confirm the extracted phrases.

faq.question: Can I refresh an existing setup?
faq.answer: Yes. When both setup files exist, it asks whether to refresh or skip. If one file is missing, it fills the gap.

faq.question: Does it send outreach?
faq.answer: No. It prepares project context and recommends related skills. Sending messages and running signal collection are outside this workflow.
